liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, and cash liquidity to revenue improved by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}.

Customer prepayments grew faster than the cash balance: contract liabilities rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}}, and advance ticket cover increased by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, above the peer median.
The rating trajectory reflects the leverage path: Fitch downgraded the company to BB+ with a stable outlook, citing slower capacity growth from the engine issues and higher leverage.

peer_positioning.text: Wizz Air has the highest EBITDA margin in the low-cost peer group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2025}}), against a median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Leverage and cash generation are the weak spots: net leverage and gross leverage are the highest of the group ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}} and {{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}}), and FFO to debt and FCF to debt are the lowest ({{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2025}} and {{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2025}}).
Interest coverage is below the peer median of {{interest_coverage.peer_median@FY2025}}, while capex intensity and cash liquidity to revenue sit in the middle of the group.

snapshot.text: Wizz Air, the low-cost carrier operating an all-Airbus narrowbody fleet, saw its credit profile weaken in FY2025 as grounded aircraft from the Pratt & Whitney engine recall held capacity broadly unchanged while revenue rose {{revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{revenue@FY2025}}.
Net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}} as EBITDA fell {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} and net debt increased {{net_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{net_debt@FY2025}}.

The point to watch is the cost base: CASK ex-fuel rose {{cask_ex_fuel.change@FY2025}} to {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2025}}, leaving interest coverage at {{interest_coverage@FY2025}} and FFO to debt at {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}}, both below the peer median.
